description_en: Jewel-tone leaded panes, black leading, sunlit arcade.
description_zh: 宝石色镶嵌玻璃、铅条线、日光回廊。

description_en: Matte clay diorama, fingerprint texture, seaside promenade.
description_zh: 哑光黏土微缩、指纹质感、海边长堤。

description_en: Two-ink riso on cream paper, halftone and slight misregister.
description_zh: 双色孔版、乳色纸、网点与轻微套印偏移。

description_en: Satin stitch and French knots on warm linen.
description_zh: 缎纹针与法国结，暖色亚麻底。

description_en: Dusty pigment on charcoal paper, festival fireworks night.
description_zh: 炭纸粉彩、颗粒晕边、烟火夜空。

description_en: Fuzzy wool craft, rainy cafe window, steam and felt rain.
description_zh: 羊毛毡纤维、雨窗咖啡馆、杯热气。

description_en: Carved gouge marks, indigo and warm orange on cream.
description_zh: 刀痕清晰、靛青与暖橙、乳色纸。

description_en: Palette-knife ridges, buttery paint, sunlit studio.
description_zh: 刮刀厚涂、油彩肌理、阳光画室。

description_en: Caustic light patterns as the dominant look (underwater scene is just the motif).
description_zh: 以焦散光效为主导画风（水下只是题材）。

description_en: Painterly aurora color bands as the dominant look.
description_zh: 以极光色带厚涂为主导画风。

description_en: Prussian-blue chemical print, rooftop kite.
description_zh: 普鲁士蓝晒像、屋顶放风筝。

description_en: Soft faceted geometry, pastel park picnic.
description_zh: 柔和切面几何、公园野餐。

description_en: Clean anime with glossy material lighting and reflective glaze sheen as the look — pottery is the scene, not the style name.
description_zh: 干净二次元 + 釉面高光材质光感；陶器是场景，不是风格名。

description_en: Parchment scrapbook / naturalist-journal collage with pressed-leaf framing — specimens are motif, collage is the style.
description_zh: 羊皮纸手账式博物拼贴；标本是题材，拼贴才是画风。

description_en: Wax-resist cracks, indigo-gold dye, night market.
description_zh: 蜡裂纹、靛金染料、夜市灯笼。

description_en: Fashion illustration on a solid flat color field; ornate lace and gloves as motif, not the style name.
description_zh: 纯色平涂底上的时尚插画；蕾丝手套是题材，不是风格名。

description_en: Painterly impasto on pure black; high contrast with white, navy, one red accent.
description_zh: 纯黑底厚涂；高对比白与海军蓝，一点红点缀。

description_en: Pop-art Ben-Day, hot pink and electric green.
description_zh: 波普网点、亮粉与电绿。

description_en: 3D-like skin and material render; rainy rooftop daylight scene.
description_zh: 半写实皮肤与材质渲染；雨后屋顶日光场景。

description_en: Gloss skin and sparkle-iris anime rendering; close framing is composition, not the style name.
description_zh: 高光皮肤与星辉瞳的二次元渲染；特写是构图，不是风格名。

description_en: Bleeding pigments, paper tooth, yellow umbrella rain.
description_zh: 水色渗化、纸纹、黄伞雨中。

description_en: Limited palette, film grain, bus-window sunset.
description_zh: 限色赛璐珞、胶片颗粒、巴士暮色。

description_en: Heavy brush contours, flat graphic blocks, skate mural.
description_zh: 粗毛笔勾线、平涂色块、滑板涂鸦墙。

description_en: Dense cross-hatch and thick contour manga-ink print language.
description_zh: 密排交叉线与粗轮廓的漫画墨线语言。

description_en: Hard daylight painting language; kitchen interior is only the motif.
description_zh: 硬日光厚涂语言；厨房只是题材。

description_en: Ink-watercolor, white negative space, teal and crimson lace.
description_zh: 水墨淡彩、留白、青绿与绯红蕾丝。

description_en: Soft painterly fantasy rendering; golden field is motif.
description_zh: 柔光幻想厚涂；金草原野是题材。

description_en: Near-monochrome black-white-grey with vivid red as the only accent color.
description_zh: 近乎黑白灰，仅用鲜红作唯一强调色。

description_en: Electric-blue midnight cityscape paint from a high balcony.
description_zh: 电蓝午夜城市厚涂；高处阳台视角。

description_en: Graphic modern woodblock / ukiyo-e anime language.
description_zh: 现代浮世绘木版感二次元语言。

description_en: Indigo-versus-ember luminous glow painting.
description_zh: 靛紫对暖金的流光厚涂。

description_en: Turquoise-and-gold filigree illustration language.
description_zh: 青绿与金箔纹样插画语言。

description_en: Mustard-gold, black, cream; disc halo and blossoms.
description_zh: 芥金黑奶油限色、圆盘光环与梅花。

description_en: High-key ice-white and cyan wash with sparse negative space.
description_zh: 高调冰白与青的晕染；大量留白。

description_en: Chiaroscuro on a void black ground; crimson marks, black dress, white lace.
description_zh: 黑底明暗法；绯红纹、黑裙白蕾丝。

description_en: Teal-and-black spot / key lighting as the dominant look; stage is motif.
description_zh: 青绿与黑的聚光主光语言；舞台是题材。

description_en: Sci-fi particle FX rendering; rings are motif.
description_zh: 科幻粒子特效渲染；光环是题材。

description_en: Polished kawaii thick-paint: silver hair, dusty-rose cafe light.
description_zh: 干净甜美厚涂：银灰发、灰粉咖啡馆光。

description_en: Glass + water-caustic rendering language; tunnel architecture is motif.
description_zh: 玻璃与水焦散渲染语言；隧道建筑是题材。

description_en: Violet-magenta glitch, chromatic fringe, luminous wings.
description_zh: 紫洋红故障、色散边、发光翼。

description_en: Dark-romantic polished illustration; lace is motif.
description_zh: 暗浪漫精致插画；蕾丝是题材。

description_en: Cinematic motion paint with Dutch tilt and fire glow.
description_zh: 电影感动势厚涂；荷兰角与火光。

description_en: Cream-peach high-key soft paint; mint-teal hair, quiet smile.
description_zh: 奶油桃色高调柔光厚涂；薄荷绿发、安静笑。

description_en: Matte opaque gouache, wet-into-wet blooms, chalky edges and bristle pulls.
description_zh: 哑光不透明水粉，湿画渗化、粉质边缘与笔毫痕迹。

description_en: Layered silk-screen spot inks, mesh grain, transparent overlaps and slight misregister.
description_zh: 分层丝网专色、网纹颗粒、透明叠色与轻微套印偏移。

description_en: Fine hatched tempera strokes, luminous matte mineral pigment on panel tooth.
description_zh: 细密排线蛋彩、哑光矿物色、木板底齿感。

description_en: Floating-ink marbling transferred to paper; concentric sumi veins as the look.
description_zh: 水面浮墨转印；同心墨纹作为主导画风。

description_en: Velvety rocked-plate grain, burnished highlights, continuous-tone black to silver.
description_zh: 摇点铜版绒黑、刮亮高光、连续调银灰。

description_en: Fused beeswax pigment, ironed layers, wax bloom and scraped ridges.
description_zh: 热熔蜂蜡颜料、熨烫叠层、蜡霜与刮痕脊。

description_en: India-ink clay board, incised white lines, knife and wire-brush hatching.
description_zh: 墨底黏土刮板、刮出白线、刀痕与钢丝刷排线。

description_en: Fine silver stylus on gesso ground, pale metal lines, faint tarnish warmth.
description_zh: 银尖在石膏底上细线、浅金属灰、微暖氧化。

description_en: Rosin-dust acid bite, velvety granulated tone, warm ink on cream rag paper.
description_zh: 松香飞尘酸蚀、绒面颗粒调子、奶油棉纸暖墨。

description_en: Discrete complementary dots of pure pigment, optical mixture, no blended stroke.
description_zh: 互补纯色点子、光学混色、无涂抹笔触。

description_en: Copper-plate drypoint with rich burr, velvety warm-black ink, plate tone on rag paper.
description_zh: 铜版干刻、绒边毛刺线、暖黑墨与纸面版调。

description_en: Monochrome grey oil modeling; cool slate and warm umber-grey, no chroma.
description_zh: 灰色单色油画塑形；冷石板灰与暖褐灰，无彩度。

description_en: Smoke-soft transitions, veiled glazes, no hard contours; form dissolves into air.
description_zh: 烟雾般柔过渡、薄釉罩染、无硬轮廓；形体溶入空气。

description_en: One-off plate impression: solvent lifts, brayer ghosts, ink residue, paper grain.
description_zh: 一次性版面转印：溶剂提墨、滚筒残影、墨渍与纸纹。

description_en: Layered pigmented gum on watercolor paper; pictorialist brush-photo hybrid.
description_zh: 水彩纸上多层色素树胶；画意摄影式笔触与影像混合。

description_en: Buon fresco: mineral pigment soaked into wet lime plaster, powdery matte tooth, faint giornate seams.
description_zh: 湿壁画：矿物色渗入湿石灰泥，粉质哑光齿感，隐约分日接缝。

description_en: Layered colored plaster; dark underlayer revealed by scratched incised lines and gouge hatching.
description_zh: 多层色泥；刮穿表层露出底色，刀痕排线与刻槽。

description_en: Greasy crayon on limestone grain, tusche washes, warm-black ink on cream rag paper.
description_zh: 石灰石蜡笔颗粒、药墨晕、奶油棉纸暖黑墨。

description_en: Iron-oxide red chalk on laid paper, stump blend, paper tooth, white-chalk heightening.
description_zh: 氧化铁红粉笔、擦笔晕、纸纹齿感、白粉笔提亮。

description_en: Meticulous ink outlines, layered mineral-color fills on silk, even graded washes in closed contours.
description_zh: 细匀墨线、矿物色多层填染、绢本闭合轮廓内均匀渲染。
